{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Build a premium modern documentation website in Next.js for a personal training system called FitForm Method. The design should feel inspired by Linear: clean dark interface, sharp typography, subtle gradients, thin borders, glassy cards, smooth spacing, elegant sidebar docs layout, and polished SaaS-style presentation. This is a fully static documentation site only, so use mock/sample content and local placeholder data, no backend, no database, no login, no payments, no real APIs. Main Goal: Create a professional docs + guide website for personal trainers and fitness clients explaining how the FitForm Method works, including workouts, nutrition basics, client onboarding, progress tracking concepts, coaching principles, and FAQ. Use Next.js with reusable components and responsive layout. Overall Style: Linear-inspired, modern, minimal, premium, dark theme first with optional light-looking sections if needed. Use colors like near-black #090A0F, charcoal #11131A, soft gray text, white headings, electric blue or violet accent gradients, subtle grid background, radial glow behind hero, clean cards with 1px borders, and smooth hover states. Layout Requirements: Sticky top navigation across the whole site with logo on left, nav links in center, and CTA button on right. Nav links: Overview, Getting Started, Training Plans, Nutrition, Progress, FAQ. Sticky nav should have blur background and subtle border when scrolling. Hero Section: Big headline: “Personal Training Docs for Stronger Coaching.” Subheadline: “A clear, structured knowledge base for trainers, clients, and teams using the FitForm Method.” Add CTA buttons: “Start Reading” and “View Programs.” Add small badge above headline: “FitForm Method v2.0 Documentation.” Add right-side preview panel showing fake docs cards, checklist items, and workout stats in a Linear-style dashboard mockup. Documentation Layout: Below hero, create a two-column docs experience. Left side sticky sidebar with docs navigation groups. Right side content area with sections, code-like callout boxes, step cards, tables, and highlighted notes. Sidebar Groups: Introduction, Coach Setup, Client Journey, Workout Library, Nutrition Guide, Progress Reviews, Safety Notes, Templates. Content Sections: 1. Overview: Explain the FitForm Method as a static documentation guide for building strength, mobility, conditioning, and sustainable habits. 2. Getting Started: Step-by-step cards for assess client goals, choose training frequency, select baseline tests, assign starter plan, review weekly progress. 3. Training Plans: Cards for Beginner Strength, Fat Loss Conditioning, Mobility Reset, Hypertrophy Split, Athletic Performance. Each card should include duration, sessions per week, difficulty, and best for. 4. Workout Structure: Show a clean table with Warm-up, Main Lift, Accessory Work, Conditioning, Cooldown. Include sample exercises and estimated time. 5. Nutrition Principles: Static educational content only, no calorie calculator needed. Include sections for protein, hydration, meal timing, habit stacking, recovery. 6. Progress Tracking Concepts: Use mock progress cards showing strength PRs, consistency streak, mobility score, energy rating. Make it visually like a dashboard but all static. 7. Client Onboarding Timeline: Horizontal or vertical timeline with Week 0 Consultation, Week 1 Baseline, Week 2 Technique, Week 4 Review, Week 8 Program Update. 8. Templates: Include static template cards for Client Intake Form, Weekly Check-in, Workout Log, Goal Review, Session Notes. 9. FAQ: Accordion-style static FAQ items, can be simple client-side interaction only. Include questions about training frequency, soreness, nutrition, equipment, progress photos, and program changes. 10. Final CTA: “Build a Better Coaching System” with buttons “Read the Guide” and “Download Sample Plan” (static button only). Components Needed: StickyNav, HeroDocsPreview, SidebarDocsNav, SectionHeader, FeatureCard, PlanCard, Timeline, StaticMetricCard, FAQAccordion, CalloutBox, Footer. Interactions: Sticky navigation, smooth anchor scrolling, active-looking sidebar states if easy, hover effects on cards, FAQ accordion open/close with local state only. No external data. Responsive: Desktop should show top nav + sidebar docs layout. Tablet should keep sidebar compact or horizontal. Mobile should stack content, nav can collapse into simple menu or wrap cleanly, sticky top nav still works, cards become single column. Content Quality: Use realistic personal training documentation copy, not lorem ipsum. Make the page feel like a real documentation/product guide for a premium coaching system. Include enough text to look complete but not overwhelming. Visual Details: Use subtle animated gradient blob, grid texture, rounded cards, pill badges, muted separators, small status labels, keyboard-style tags, and Linear-style clean spacing. Footer: Include logo, short description, docs links, resources links, and small note: “Static demo documentation site — sample content only.” Deliverable: A complete static Next.js front-end website with clean component structure and modern CSS/Tailwind styling if available. It should run locally without any backend or external services.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
